scope: ONLY07 frozen revision003: public error/receipt sinks and supplied SDK leader evidence. Supplemental to unchanged historical one-shot peer; not a rewrite of its prior PASS or live evidence.

runtime.networkBoundary: Every fetch/provider operation is controlled fictional I/O; no real RPC/UI/wallet

findings.source: Arbitrary Error text from actual official SDK gen_call/provider/postproof business-read I/O.
findings.control: run catches the exception and directly calls log(error.message). log copies it to notice and a trail node.
findings.reachableEvidence: Both packages actual main Load, ordinary Open provider error and resumed original-hash postproof read error display the independent fictional noncredential sentinel. No module or WalletSession was mocked.
findings.impact: Unexpected remote/provider error details are displayed publicly within the application rather than constrained to a fixed diagnostic.
findings.counterevidence: No real private data, exfiltration or active attack was used or shown. The one-shot ABI fallback error path itself produced its guard message rather than echoing the original sentinel. Existing unknown metadata blocks resubmission.
findings.minimalFixDirection: Use fixed public diagnostics for I/O errors at actual run/report boundaries; leave original pending/hash and public validated hash fields intact.

findings.source: A previously proven A receipt in WalletSession.evidence plus record/address/account/chain context change or later plain read.
findings.control: clear invalidates chain record but never clears receipt. accept renders wallet.evidence unconditionally, including after plain read of another visible context.
findings.sink: Receipt panel next to a different visible or loaded record/wallet context.
findings.reachableEvidence: For each package a successful A Observe is followed by recordId/address/account/chain change: receipt remains. For record and address cases, successful B read still displays A hash. Same-context plain read also republishes old evidence.
findings.impact: A true receipt for A can be presented next to B or a disconnected/new wallet without explicit original-context binding. This is display misattribution, not a demonstrated wrong-chain write.
findings.counterevidence: The receipt being displayed passed original SDK/raw proof for A. Context tokens correctly discard a newly completing delayed A read after ID/address/account/chain changes; none of those delayed cases displays a new A record. No wrong target/signer action was observed.
findings.minimalFixDirection: Clear public receipt immediately on context/load/action changes; display receipt only from the just-completed act/resume after current token and domain validation, with explicit original public context. A plain read must not reuse WalletSession.evidence.

findings.source: Actual SDK receipt explicitly supplies consensus_data.leader_receipt=[] or only mode=validator entries, followed by independently valid successful raw receipt for the exact original transaction.
findings.control: The check rejects leaders.length>1 or failed leaders, allowing zero mode=leader entries in a supplied list.
findings.sink: Observe completion, pending clearing and receipt display.
findings.reachableEvidence: Both packages actual original-hash Observe accept supplied [] and validator-only, display receipt, execute business read and remove exact saved pending. The transport gives the first SDK response that explicit list and the second raw response a valid unique mode=leader SUCCESS.
findings.impact: An explicit absence of SDK leader evidence is treated like an omitted optional field, weakening the intended conflict check across supplied observations.
findings.counterevidence: Independent raw still must be FINALIZED, NORMAL, zero value, exact hash/from/target, MAJORITY_AGREE and unique successful mode=leader. No false raw success or failed transaction acceptance was demonstrated. SDK multiple/failed leaders and bad raw binding remain rejected with original pending retained.
findings.minimalFixDirection: If SDK leader_receipt is present, require object-shaped entries and exactly one mode=leader with SUCCESS. Continue allowing truly missing optional SDK fields only when strict independent raw proof succeeds.

retainedControls: Generic original-provider unknown and official could-not-decode fallback each invoke the original provider exactly once, retain hash:null public intent and block a forced second Open event.

Postproof business-read error retains exact original saved hash/context bytes. Bad raw sender or array-shaped leader execution and SDK multiple/failed leaders retain the exact original pending and show no receipt.
Fresh delayed A callback after record/address/account/chain changes is rejected by RecordContext, so this is not a new write-ID race.
Normal Open and original-hash Observe still execute through official five-parameter SDK envelope with zero value and one original mutation.
Validated source-only Blob exports omit receipt hash and fictional service sentinel.
Delayed duplicate identical accounts/chain events keep the valid existing account; actual changed events invalidate account/loaded state.
limits: Only additional public-sink/SDK-supplied-leader boundaries tested; not a repeat full security review or full frontend/build/contract suite.
Every runtime service/provider response is synthetic; no real private information is read, persisted or claimed to leak. No exploit/exfiltration or wrong-signature claim.
Does not undo independently verified real Open→Derive→Confirm evidence or modify historical003 peer PASS; the new report requests a separately reviewed subsequent revision if root chooses.
Unknown/pending proof controls are reported from the exact probes, not a claim all possible provider/storage/concurrency cases are covered.
No real UI/provider/RPC/network/chain mutation, website/asset/source/package/oldstage/central edits occurred.
